newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold easier in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold easier in subdued trade.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange remained subdued on Wednesday, with volume sliding to 667 kilos from Tuesday's 790 kilos, as traders were sidelined and awaiting direction from world markets, dealers said.
Gold edged lower to close at $339.60 an ounce and 1,600,000 lira per gram, compared to $340.00 and 1,600,500 lira on Tuesday, following bearish sentiment on European markets.
The Turkish lira weakened slightly to 146,700 against the dollar from Tuesday's 146,460 close, cushioning the gold's drop in lira terms.
Most of the day's trade -- 527 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 58.0 percent of the total trade was made in lira. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
